correctness.rationale: The exact bijection from seven-one words to six nonnegative internal gap variables plus trailing zeros follows from the full 15-window gap criterion; the resulting lattice count is exactly an Ehrhart count in a full-dimensional rational six-polytope. The supplied self-contained integer/rational checker exhausts every five-active-constraint system from 21 forms, obtains 14 extreme rays, finds 155 faces and 2184 exact-simplex flags, and sums determinants to the irreducible volume 289/2488320. A separate numerical-hull triangulation gave the same rational value; direct word and gap enumerations independently agree for n=7..17. These finite checks supplement, and do not replace, the general Ehrhart step. All boundary conditions n>=7, fixed weight seven, first symbol one, and n<7 zero are explicit.

originality.rationale: The closest same-object primary source, Burcsi et al. arXiv:1611.09017v1, establishes general rationality and prints generating functions for fixed weights only 0 through 6; it explicitly reports inability to extend concrete formulas past six. Its gap inequalities alone do not supply the new six-dimensional exact volume 289/2488320 or the equivalent conditional probability 289/3456. Later all-density asymptotics and combinatorial generation papers do not imply this coefficient. Targeted exact-fraction, alternate formulation, word-weight, Ehrhart-polytope, research-record, and OEIS searches found no equivalent or broader explicit result; residual possibility of unindexed computation is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed later calculation of the same six-dimensional volume or equivalent fixed-density-seven asymptotic may exist; absence in retrieved searches is not a proof of first discovery.
The exact volume is computer-assisted via finite exact-arithmetic enumeration. Full independent audit of code and mathematical premises has not been performed.

value.rationale: The seven-one class is the first fixed density beyond the exact generating-function table of Burcsi et al.; an explicit rational leading coefficient was not determined there. The 14-ray, 155-face cone calculation is nontrivial and exact, yields the natural limiting 289/3456 fraction of seven-one words that are prefix normal among those starting with one, and supplies a quantitative benchmark for fixed-density prefix-normal enumeration. This is a motivated unknown invariant, not a routine renaming of generic rationality or an arbitrary isolated finite input; no claim to the uncomputed full GF is made.
